NaturalMeaning: to make use of; take advantage of
Context: Commonly used when making good use of time, an opportunity, or a resource.

Grammar.function: use an opportunity or situation to do something
Grammar.meaning_in_example: take the opportunity to do something

Usage: A high-frequency verb used for opportunities, time, resources, and favorable situations.
Pronunciation: Stress falls on the final syllable.
NaturalSpeech: Inside a sentence, keep the verb inside the surrounding rhythmic group rather than isolating it.

Examples.Text: Voy a aprovechar el fin de semana para descansar.
Examples.NaturalMeaning: I'm going to take advantage of the weekend to rest.

Examples.Text: Aprovechamos el buen tiempo para salir a caminar.
Examples.NaturalMeaning: We took advantage of the good weather to go for a walk.

Examples.Text: Quiero aprovechar esta oportunidad para aprender más.
Examples.NaturalMeaning: I want to take advantage of this opportunity to learn more.

Examples.Text: Hay que aprovechar mejor el tiempo.
Examples.NaturalMeaning: We need to make better use of our time.
